'''Dreambubble''' was the term used by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to describe the state of deep [[Dream/Legends|dreaming]] that often accompanied a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-induced hibernation. Although the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who went into hibernation were not technically [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]], they could still dream, and the experience of dreaming while in hibernation was described as being in a self-contained bubble.
